field.name: includeDownloadLink
field.comment: true: every image is offered with a link that downloads it; false: it is not

field.name: eID
field.comment: The ID of the image of the gallery

field.name: idx
field.comment: The position of the image in the gallery, starting from zero

field.name: fID
field.comment: The ID of the file holding the image

field.name: dcID
field.comment: The ID of the display choice

field.name: entryID
field.comment: The ID of the image of the gallery the display choice belongs to

field.name: value
field.comment: The text of the caption, or wide or standard for the size

field.name: dcKey
field.comment: caption: the row holds the caption of the image; hover_caption: the caption displayed while the pointer is over it; size: how wide the image is
